articles.title: Disclosure Day Grey Alien UFO / UAP Occupant design explorations shared by Concept Artist Daniel Baker!
articles.summary: Disclosure Day Grey Alien UFO / UAP Occupant design explorations shared by Concept Artist Daniel Baker! | Disclosure Day Movie News Disclosure Day Grey Alien UFO / UAP Occupant design explorations shared by Concept Artist Daniel Baker! Concept artist Daniel Baker provided a number of alternative designs for Disclosure Day's take on the classic Grey Alien and THEIR UFO/UAP occupants. One of the prominent concept artists who got to work on Steven Spielberg's Disclosure Day was Daniel Baker and recently he's taken to social media to debut some of the phenomenal artwork he provided for the film! Below are a few explorations he shared of the film's take on the classic Grey Alien – a slender humanoid extraterrestrial with large eyes, pale skin and a frail body.

articles.title: Journalist says UAP waiver may allow disclosures on recovered non-human craft 2026 | JUSTICE - IUSTITIA.BG 2025
articles.summary: A new waiver lets UAP whistleblowers—including current and former military personnel and contractors—disclose information without legal risk, superseding existing nondisclosure and Special Access Program agreements. Avi Loeb, head of the UAP Science Advisory Council, said the waiver will allow sharing of previously undisclosed data with the Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters (PURSUE), though some details may still remain confidential. Loeb indicated that the waiver could reveal recovered non‑human craft if the information qualifies, and that it may help determine whether the U.S. government possesses non‑human‑made technologies. He stressed that new firsthand accounts and scientific evidence are needed to move beyond inconclusive footage, and that the waiver could be crucial if the government holds undisclosed tangible evidence.

articles.title: The Evidence Around UAPs Is Getting Harder to Ignore
articles.summary: png) 0:00 -10:15 Audio 3 Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence – such is the case on Non-Human Intelligence (NHI) and Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAPs). I have had no personal firsthand experience with either, but there is evidence mounting, and it has been significant enough that it has captured my attention. I want to share the way I think about this — not as a believer, not as a skeptic, but as someone who takes data seriously enough to know when too much is happening not to pay attention. On August 31, 2026, at the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, the UAP Science Advisory Council was informed that the United States government has a ‘**preparedness plan in place’** should the existence of nonhuman intelligence (NHI) be confirmed.

en.title: The Evidence Around UAPs Is Getting Harder to Ignore
en.summary: png) 0:00 -10:15 Audio 3 Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence – such is the case on Non-Human Intelligence (NHI) and Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAPs). I have had no personal firsthand experience with either, but there is evidence mounting, and it has been significant enough that it has captured my attention. I want to share the way I think about this — not as a believer, not as a skeptic, but as someone who takes data seriously enough to know when too much is happening not to pay attention.

de.title: Die Beweise für UAPs werden immer schwerer zu ignorieren
de.summary: png) 0:00 -10:15 Audio 3 Außergewöhnliche Ansprüche erfordern außergewöhnliche Beweise – dies ist der Fall bei nicht-menschlicher Intelligenz (nhi) und nicht identifizierten anomalen Phänomenen (UAPs). Ich habe keine persönlichen Erfahrungen aus erster Hand mit beiden gemacht, aber es gibt immer mehr Beweise, und es war signifikant genug, dass es meine Aufmerksamkeit erregt hat. Ich möchte die Art und Weise teilen, wie ich darüber denke — nicht als Gläubiger, nicht als Skeptiker, sondern als jemand, der Daten aufnimmt ernst genug, um zu wissen, wann zu viel passiert, um nicht darauf zu achten.
